rachel (mktg): quick heads-up before tomorrow's KPI review  our launch post A/B (messaging alpha vs beta) shows a 22% higher raw lead count in the dash for variant B, but HubSpot shows similar counts across variants. anyone see obvious attribution drift? :thinking:
dave (analytics): dash is counting event rows and attributing by "last_click" for A/B experiments; HS is tagging via form-submission payloads which preserve the utm_campaign but not the experiment variant. that mismatch could explain it
ani: also noticed many variant B clicks came from a paid boost with query params that strip the experiment cookie. so variant labeling might be lost before form submit
mike (revops): if the CDN or ad redirect strips cookies, HS will only see the utm_campaign and lose "variant=B". revops logs show ~34 ad-click redirects that removed cookies on 03-12
sophia (growth): okay action list: 1) dave run a dedupe (distinct email) by utm+variant vs event rows 2) mike export redirect log slice 3) ani compute variant conversion-to-MQL to see quality differences 4) kyle check SFDC owners for top 15 leads from variant B
dave (analytics): running quick SQL now:
```sql
select coalesce(utm_campaign,'no-utmc') || '|' || coalesce(experiment_variant,'no-variant') as cohort, count(distinct email) as unique_leads
from events.lead_events
where received_at between '2026-03-10' and '2026-03-16'
and page_path ilike '%/launch%'
group by 1
order by unique_leads desc;
```
results in ~3 mins
report-bot: weekly-kpi-snapshot: dash_raw_variantB=512, dash_raw_variantA=421, hubspot_variantA_tagged=295, hubspot_variantB_tagged=305
ani: early check shows variant B has slightly higher top-of-funnel but conversion-to-mql is 14% vs variant A 18%  quality may favor A despite B driving more clicks
mike (revops): redirect logs attached to this thread (private CSV) show 34 redirects that drop cookies; approx 28 of those map to variant B ad boost. we should add a reconciliation line "redirect-lost-variant" on the one-pager
kyle (sales-bdm): SFDC shows ~290 leads routed to SDRs for that week; of the top 15 by ARR from variant B, 3 were fast-routed to enterprise and lost the original variant tag during handoff
sophia (growth): for the KPI readout let's show: 1) event-row raw counts (dash) 2) deduped unique emails by cohort 3) HS-tagged form submissions by campaign 4) variant-level conv->MQL and median time-to-mql 5) reconciliation notes for redirect-lost-variant + enterprise routing
dave (analytics): SQL finished: deduped unique leads: variantB=462, variantA=398, total distinct=780. difference vs raw is from repeated clicks and event granularity
rachel (mktg): excellent. please post the dedupe numbers, mike attach the redirect CSV, ani post conv->MQL numbers, and kyle confirm owners for the 3 enterprise leads. meet TOM 9:00 to finalize the A/B readout and recommended messaging pivot if quality favors A :rocket:
